name: Victini
blackDescription: This Pokemon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.
whiteDescription: It creates an unlimited supply of energy inside its body, which it shares with those who touch it.

name: Snivy
blackDescription: It is very intelligent and calm. Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes its movements swifter.
whiteDescription: They photosynthesize by bathing their tails in sunlight. When they are not feeling well, their tails droop.

name: Servine
blackDescription: It moves along the ground as if sliding. Its swift movements befuddle its foes, and it then attacks with a vine whip.
whiteDescription: They avoid attacks by sinking into the shadows of thick foliage. They retaliate with masterful whipping techniques.

name: Serperior
blackDescription: It can stop its opponents’ movements with just a glare. It takes in solar energy and boosts it internally.
whiteDescription: They raise their heads to intimidate opponents but only give it their all when fighting a powerful opponent.

name: Tepig
blackDescription: It can deftly dodge its foe’s attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.
whiteDescription: It blows fire through its nose. When it catches a cold, the fire becomes pitch-black smoke instead.

name: Pignite
blackDescription: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.
whiteDescription: Whatever it eats becomes fuel for the flame in its stomach. When it is angered, the intensity of the flame increases.

name: Emboar
blackDescription: It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.
whiteDescription: It has mastered fast and powerful fighting moves. It grows a beard of fire.

name: Oshawott
blackDescription: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.
whiteDescription: The scalchop on its stomach is made from the same elements as claws. It detaches the scalchop for use as a blade.

name: Dewott
blackDescription: Strict training is how it learns its flowing double-scalchop technique.
whiteDescription: Scalchop techniques differ from one Dewott to another. It never neglects maintaining its scalchops.

name: Samurott
blackDescription: One swing of the sword incorporated in its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them quiets everybody.
whiteDescription: Part of the armor on its anterior legs becomes a giant sword. Its cry alone is enough to intimidate most enemies.

name: Patrat
blackDescription: Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days. They use their tails to communicate with others.
whiteDescription: Extremely cautious, they take shifts to maintain a constant watch of their nest. They feel insecure without a lookout.

name: Watchog
blackDescription: When they see an enemy, their tails stand high, and they spit the seeds of berries stored in their cheek pouches.
whiteDescription: They make the patterns on their bodies shine in order to threaten predators. Keen eyesight lets them see in the dark.

name: Lillipup
blackDescription: It faces strong opponents with great courage. But, when at a disadvantage in a fight, this intelligent Pokemon flees.
white description: The long hair around its face provides an amazing radar that lets it sense subtle changes in its surroundings.

name: Herdier
blackDescription: It has black, cape-like fur that is very hard and decreases the amount of damage it receives.
whiteDescription: It loyally follows its Trainer’s orders. For ages, they have helped Trainers raise Pokemon.

name: Stoutland
blackDescription: It rescues people stranded by blizzards in the mountains. Its shaggy fur shields it from the cold.
whiteDescription: This extremely wise Pokemon excels at rescuing people stranded at sea or in the mountains.

name: Purrloin
blackDescription: They steal from people for fun, but their victims can’t help but forgive them. Their deceptively cute act is perfect.
whiteDescription: Its cute act is a ruse. When victims let down their guard, they find their items taken. It attacks with sharp claws.

name: Liepard
blackDescription: These Pokemon vanish and appear unexpectedly. Many Trainers are drawn to their beautiful form and fur.
whiteDescription: Stealthily, it sneaks up on its target, striking from behind before its victim has a chance to react.

name: Pansage
blackDescription: This Pokemon dwells deep in the forest. Eating a leaf from its head whisks weariness away as if by magic.
whiteDescription: It shares the leaf on its head with weary-looking Pokemon. These leaves are known to relieve stress.

name: Simisage
blackDescription: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.
whiteDescription: It attacks enemies with strikes of its thorn-covered tail. This Pokemon is wild tempered.

name: Pansear
blackDescription: When it is angered, the temperature of its head tuft reaches 600° F. It uses its tuft to roast berries.
whiteDescription: This Pokemon lives in caves in volcanoes. The fire within the tuft on its head can reach 600° F.

name: Simisear
blackDescription: It loves sweets because they become energy for the fire burning inside its body.
whiteDescription: A flame burns inside its body. It scatters embers from its head and tail to sear its opponents.

name: Panpour
blackDescription: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.
whiteDescription: It does not thrive in dry environments. It keeps itself damp by shooting water stored in its head tuft from its tail.

name: Simipour
blackDescription: The tuft on its head holds water. When the level runs low, it replenishes the tuft by siphoning up water with its tail.
whiteDescription: The high-pressure water expelled from its tail is so powerful, it can destroy a concrete wall.

name: Munna
blackDescription: Munna always float in the air. People whose dreams are eaten by them forget what the dreams had been about.
whiteDescription: It eats the dreams of people and Pokemon. When it eats a pleasant dream, it expels pink-colored mist.

name: Musharna
blackDescription: The mist emanating from their foreheads is packed with the dreams of people and Pokemon.
whiteDescription: With the mist from its forehead, it can create shapes of things from dreams it has eaten.

name: Pidove
blackDescription: Each follows its Trainer’s orders as best it can, but they sometimes fail to understand complicated commands.
whiteDescription: These Pokemon live in cities. They are accustomed to people. Flocks often gather in parks and plazas.

name: Tranquill
blackDescription: It can return to its Trainer’s location regardless of the distance separating them.
whiteDescription: Many people believe that, deep in the forest where Tranquill live, there is a peaceful place where there is no war.

name: Unfezant
blackDescription: Males swing their head plumage to threaten opponents. The females’ flying abilities surpass those of the males.
whiteDescription: Males have plumage on their heads. They will never let themselves feel close to anyone other than their Trainers.

name: Blitzle
blackDescription: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use their flashing manes to communicate with one another.
whiteDescription: When thunderclouds cover the sky, it will appear. It can catch lightning with its mane and store the electricity.

name: Zebstrika
blackDescription: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.
whiteDescription: This ill-tempered Pokemon is dangerous because when it’s angry, it shoots lightning from its mane in all directions.

name: Roggenrola
blackDescription: Its ear is hexagonal in shape. Compressed underground, its body is as hard as steel.
whiteDescription: They were discovered a hundred years ago in an earthquake fissure. Inside each one is an energy core.

name: Boldore
blackDescription: When it overflows with power, the orange crystal on its body glows. It looks for underground water in caves.
whiteDescription: Because its energy was too great to be contained, the energy leaked and formed orange crystals.

name: Gigalith
blackDescription: Compressing the energy from its internal core lets it fire off an attack capable of blowing away a mountain.
whiteDescription: The solar energy absorbed by its body’s orange crystals is magnified internally and fired from its mouth.

name: Woobat
blackDescription: Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.
whiteDescription: Suction from its nostrils enables it to stick to cave walls during sleep. It leaves a heart-shaped mark behind.

name: Swoobat
blackDescription: It emits sound waves of various frequencies from its nose, including some powerful enough to destroy rocks.
whiteDescription: Anyone who comes into contact with the ultrasonic waves emitted by a courting male experiences a positive mood shift.

name: Drilbur
blackDescription: It can dig through the ground at a speed of 30 mph. It could give a car running above ground a good race.
whiteDescription: It makes its way swiftly through the soil by putting both claws together and rotating at high speed.

name: Excadrill
blackDescription: It can help in tunnel construction. Its drill has evolved into steel strong enough to bore through iron plates.
whiteDescription: More than 300 feet below the surface, they build mazelike nests. Their activity can be destructive to subway tunnels.

name: Audino
blackDescription: It touches others with the feelers on its ears, using the sound of their heartbeats to tell how they are feeling.
whiteDescription: Its auditory sense is astounding. It has a radar like ability to understand its surroundings through slight sounds.

name: Timburr
blackDescription: It fights by swinging a piece of lumber around. It is close to evolving when it can handle the lumber without difficulty.
whiteDescription: These Pokemon appear at building sites and help out with construction. They always carry squared logs.

name: Gurdurr
blackDescription: This Pokemon is so muscular and strongly built that even a group of wrestlers could not make it budge an inch.
whiteDescription: They strengthen their bodies by carrying steel beams. They show off their big muscles to their friends.

name: Conkeldurr
blackDescription: It is thought that Conkeldurr taught humans how to make concrete more than 2,000 years ago.
whiteDescription: They use concrete pillars as walking canes. They know moves that enable them to swing the pillars freely in battle.

name: Tympole
blackDescription: They warn others of danger by vibrating their cheeks to create a high-pitched sound.
whiteDescription: By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans. It uses the rhythm of these sounds to talk.

name: Palpitoad
blackDescription: When they vibrate the bumps on their heads, they can make waves in water or earthquake-like vibrations on land.
whiteDescription: It lives in the water and on land. It uses its long, sticky tongue to capture prey.

name: Seismitoad
blackDescription: They shoot paralyzing liquid from their head bumps. They use vibration to hurt their opponents.
whiteDescription: It increases the power of its punches by vibrating the bumps on its fists. It can turn a boulder to rubble with one punch.

name: Throh
blackDescription: When it tightens its belt, it becomes stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave their own belts.
whiteDescription: When they encounter foes bigger than themselves, they try to throw them. They always travel in packs of five.

name: Sawk
blackDescription: The sound of Sawk punching boulders and trees can be heard all the way from the mountains where they train.
whiteDescription: Tying their belts gets them pumped and makes their punches more destructive. Disturbing their training angers them.

name: Sewaddle
blackDescription: Leavanny dress it in clothes they made for it when it hatched. It hides its head in its hood while it is sleeping.
whiteDescription: This Pokemon makes clothes for itself. It chews up leaves and sews them with sticky thread extruded from its mouth.

name: Swadloon
blackDescription: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.
whiteDescription: It protects itself from the cold by wrapping up in leaves. It stays on the move, eating leaves in forests.

name: Leavanny
blackDescription: Upon finding a small Pokemon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves, using the cutters on its arms and sticky silk.
whiteDescription: It keeps its eggs warm with heat from fermenting leaves. It also uses leaves to make warm wrappings for Sewaddle.

name: Venipede
blackDescription: Its bite injects a potent poison, enough to paralyze large bird Pokemon that try to prey on it.
whiteDescription: It discovers what is going on around it by using the feelers on its head and tail. It is brutally aggressive.

name: Whirlipede
blackDescription: Protected by a hard shell, it spins its body like a wheel and crashes furiously into its enemies.
whiteDescription: It is usually motionless, but when attacked, it rotates at high speed and then crashes into its opponent.

name: Scolipede
blackDescription: With quick movements, it chases down its foes, attacking relentlessly with its horns until it prevails.
whiteDescription: Highly aggressive, it uses the claws near its neck to dig into its opponents and poison them.

name: Cottonee
blackDescription: When attacked, it escapes by shooting cotton from its body. The cotton serves as a decoy to distract the attacker.
whiteDescription: They go wherever the wind takes them. On rainy days, their bodies are heavier, so they take shelter beneath big trees.

name: Whimsicott
blackDescription: Like the wind, it can slip through any gap, no matter how small. It leaves balls of white fluff behind.
whiteDescription: Riding whirlwinds, they appear. These Pokemon sneak through gaps into houses and cause all sorts of mischief.

name: Petilil
blackDescription: The leaves on its head are very bitter. Eating one of these leaves is known to refresh a tired body.
whiteDescription: Since they prefer moist, nutrient-rich soil, the areas where Petilil live are known to be good for growing plants.

name: Lilligant
blackDescription: Even veteran Trainers face a challenge in getting its beautiful flower to bloom. This Pokemon is popular with celebrities.
whiteDescription: The fragrance of the garland on its head has a relaxing effect. It withers if a Trainer does not take good care of it.

name: Basculin
blackDescription: Red and blue Basculin get along so poorly, they’ll start fighting instantly. These Pokemon are very hostile.
whiteDescription: Red and blue Basculin usually do not get along, but sometimes members of one school mingle with the other’s school.

name: Sandile
blackDescription: They live buried in the sands of the desert. The sun-warmed sands prevent their body temperature from dropping.
whiteDescription: It moves along below the sand’s surface, except for its nose and eyes. A dark membrane shields its eyes from the sun.

name: Krokorok
blackDescription: They live in groups of a few individuals. Protective membranes shield their eyes from sandstorms.
whiteDescription: The special membrane covering its eyes can sense the heat of objects, so it can see its surroundings even in darkness.

name: Krookodile
blackDescription: They never allow prey to escape. Their jaws are so powerful, they can crush the body of an automobile.
whiteDescription: It can expand the focus of its eyes, enabling it to see objects in the far distance as if it were using binoculars.

name: Darumaka
blackDescription: When its internal fire is burning, it cannot calm down and it runs around. When the fire diminishes, it falls asleep.
whiteDescription: Darumaka’s droppings are hot, so people used to put them in their clothes to keep themselves warm.

name: Darmanitan
blackDescription: Its internal fire burns at 2,500° F, making enough power that it can destroy a dump truck with one punch.
whiteDescription: When weakened in battle, it transforms into a stone statue. Then it sharpens its mind and fights on mentally.

name: Maractus
blackDescription: It uses an up-tempo song and dance to drive away the bird Pokemon that prey on its flower seeds.
whiteDescription: Arid regions are their habitat. They move rhythmically, making a sound similar to maracas.

name: Dwebble
blackDescription: This Pokemon can easily melt holes in hard rocks with a liquid secreted from its mouth.
whiteDescription: It makes a hole in a suitable rock. If that rock breaks, the Pokemon remains agitated until it locates a replacement.

name: Crustle
blackDescription: Competing for territory, Crustle fight viciously. The one whose boulder is broken is the loser of the battle.
whiteDescription: It possesses legs of enormous strength, enabling it to carry heavy slabs for many days, even when crossing arid land.

name: Scraggy
blackDescription: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.
whiteDescription: It immediately headbutts anyone that makes eye contact with it. Its skull is massively thick.

name: Scrafty
blackDescription: Groups of them beat up anything that enters their territory. Each can spit acidic liquid from its mouth.
whiteDescription: It can smash concrete blocks with its kicking attacks. The one with the biggest crest is the group leader.

name: Sigilyph
blackDescription: They never vary the route they fly, because their memories of guarding an ancient city remain steadfast.
whiteDescription: The guardians of an ancient city, they use their psychic power to attack enemies that invade their territory.

name: Yamask
blackDescription: Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human. Sometimes they look at it and cry.
whiteDescription: These Pokemon arose from the spirits of people interred in graves in past ages. Each retains memories of its former life.

name: Cofagrigus
blackDescription: It has been said that they swallow those who get too close and turn them into mummies. They like to eat gold nuggets.
whiteDescription: They pretend to be elaborate coffins to teach lessons to grave robbers. Their bodies are covered in pure gold.

name: Tirtouga
blackDescription: Restored from a fossil, this Pokemon can dive to depths beyond half a mile.
whiteDescription: About 100 million years ago, these Pokemon swam in oceans. It is thought they also went on land to attack prey.

name: Carracosta
blackDescription: They can live both in the ocean and on land. A slap from one of them is enough to open a hole in the bottom of a tanker.
whiteDescription: Incredible jaw strength enables them to chew up steel beams and rocks along with their prey.

name: Archen
blackDescription: Said to be an ancestor of bird Pokemon, they were unable to fly and moved about by hopping from one branch to another.
whiteDescription: Revived from a fossil, this Pokemon is thought to be the ancestor of all bird Pokemon.

name: Archeops
blackDescription: They are intelligent and will cooperate to catch prey. From the ground, they use a running start to take flight.
whiteDescription: It runs better than it flies. It catches prey by running at speeds comparable to those of an automobile.

name: Trubbish
blackDescription: Inhaling the gas they belch will make you sleep for a week. They prefer unsanitary places.
whiteDescription: The combination of garbage bags and industrial waste caused the chemical reaction that created this Pokemon.

name: Garbodor
blackDescription: It clenches opponents with its left arm and finishes them off with foul-smelling poison gas belched from its mouth.
whiteDescription: They absorb garbage and make it part of their bodies. They shoot a poisonous liquid from their right-hand fingertips.

name: Zorua
blackDescription: It changes into the forms of others to surprise them. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.
whiteDescription: To protect themselves from danger, they hide their true identities by transforming into people and Pokemon.

name: Zoroark
blackDescription: Bonds between these Pokemon are very strong. It protects the safety of its pack by tricking its opponents.
whiteDescription: Each has the ability to fool a large group of people simultaneously. They protect their lair with illusory scenery.

name: Minccino
blackDescription: They greet one another by rubbing each other with their tails, which are always kept well groomed and clean.
whiteDescription: These Pokemon prefer a tidy habitat. They are always sweeping and dusting, using their tails as brooms.

name: Cinccino
blackDescription: Their white fur is coated in a special oil that makes it easy for them to deflect attacks.
whiteDescription: Their white fur feels amazing to touch. Their fur repels dust and prevents static electricity from building up.

name: Gothita
blackDescription: Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.
whiteDescription: They intently observe both Trainers and Pokemon. Apparently, they are looking at something that only Gothita can see.

name: Gothorita
blackDescription: They use hypnosis to control people and Pokemon. Tales of Gothorita leading people astray are told in every corner.
whiteDescription: Starlight is the source of their power. At night, they mark star positions by using psychic power to float stones.

name: Gothitelle
blackDescription: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power.
whiteDescription: They can predict the future from the placement and movement of the stars. They can see Trainers’ life spans.

name: Solosis
blackDescription: They drive away attackers by unleashing psychic power. They can use telepathy to talk with others.
whiteDescription: Because their bodies are enveloped in a special liquid, they can survive in any environment.

name: Duosion
blackDescription: Since they have two divided brains, at times they suddenly try to take two different actions at once.
whiteDescription: When their brains, now divided in two, are thinking the same thoughts, these Pokemon exhibit their maximum power.

name: Reuniclus
blackDescription: When Reuniclus shake hands, a network forms between their brains, increasing their psychic power.
whiteDescription: These remarkably intelligent Pokemon fight by controlling arms that can grip with rock-crushing power.

name: Ducklett
blackDescription: These bird Pokemon are excellent divers. They swim around in the water eating their favorite food--peat moss.
whiteDescription: When attacked, it uses its feathers to splash water, escaping under cover of the spray.

name: Swanna
blackDescription: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.
whiteDescription: It administers sharp, powerful pecks with its bill. It whips its long neck to deliver forceful repeated strikes.

name: Vanillite
blackDescription: The temperature of their breath is -58° F. They create snow crystals and make snow fall in the areas around them.
whiteDescription: This Pokemon formed from icicles bathed in energy from the morning sun. It sleeps buried in snow.

name: Vanillish
blackDescription: Snowy mountains are this Pokemon’s habitat. During an ancient ice age, they moved to southern areas.
whiteDescription: It conceals itself from enemy eyes by creating many small ice particles and hiding among them.

name: Vanilluxe
blackDescription: Swallowing large amounts of water, they make snow clouds inside their bodies and attack their foes with violent blizzards.
whiteDescription: If both heads get angry simultaneously, this Pokemon expels a blizzard, burying everything in snow.

name: Deerling
blackDescription: The color and scent of their fur changes to match the mountain grass. When they sense hostility, they hide in the grass.
whiteDescription: The turning of the seasons changes the color and scent of this Pokemon’s fur. People use it to mark the seasons.

name: Sawsbuck
blackDescription: They migrate according to the seasons. People can tell the season by looking at Sawsbuck’s horns.
whiteDescription: The plants growing on its horns change according to the season. The leaders of the herd possess magnificent horns.

name: Emolga
blackDescription: The energy made in its cheeks’ electric pouches is stored inside its membrane and released while it is gliding.
whiteDescription: They live on treetops and glide using the inside of a cape-like membrane while discharging electricity.

name: Karrablast
blackDescription: These mysterious Pokemon evolve when they receive electrical stimulation while they are in the same place as Shelmet.
whiteDescription: When they feel threatened, they spit an acidic liquid to drive attackers away. This Pokemon targets Shelmet.

name: Escavalier
blackDescription: They fly around at high speed, striking with their pointed spears. Even when in trouble, they face opponents bravely.
whiteDescription: These Pokemon evolve by wearing the shell covering of a Shelmet. The steel armor protects their whole body.

name: Foongus
blackDescription: It lures people in with its Poke Ball pattern, then releases poison spores. Why it resembles a Poke Ball is unknown.
whiteDescription: For some reason, this Pokemon resembles a Poke Ball. They release poison spores to repel those who try to catch them.

name: Amoonguss
blackDescription: It lures prey close by dancing and waving its arm caps, which resemble Poke Balls, in a swaying motion.
whiteDescription: They show off their Poke Ball caps to lure prey, but very few Pokemon are fooled by this.

name: Frillish
blackDescription: With its thin, veil-like arms wrapped around the body of its opponent, it sinks to the ocean floor.
whiteDescription: They paralyze prey with poison, then drag them down to their lairs, five miles below the surface.

name: Jellicent
blackDescription: The fate of the ships and crew that wander into Jellicent’s habitat: all sunken, all lost, all vanished.
whiteDescription: They propel themselves by expelling absorbed seawater from their bodies. Their favorite food is life energy.

name: Alomomola
blackDescription: The special membrane enveloping Alomomola has the ability to heal wounds.
whiteDescription: Floating in the open sea is how they live. When they find a wounded Pokemon, they embrace it and bring it to shore.

name: Joltik
blackDescription: Joltik that live in cities have learned a technique for sucking electricity from the outlets in houses.
whiteDescription: They attach themselves to large-bodied Pokemon and absorb static electricity, which they store in an electric pouch.

name: Galvantula
blackDescription: When attacked, they create an electric barrier by spitting out many electrically charged threads.
whiteDescription: They employ an electrically charged web to trap their prey. While it is immobilized by shock, they leisurely consume it.

name: Ferroseed
blackDescription: When threatened, it attacks by shooting a barrage of spikes, which gives it a chance to escape by rolling away.
whiteDescription: They stick their spikes into cave walls and absorb the minerals they find in the rock.

name: Ferrothorn
blackDescription: It fights by swinging around its three spiky feelers. A hit from these steel spikes can reduce a boulder to rubble.
whiteDescription: They attach themselves to cave ceilings, firing steel spikes at targets passing beneath them.

name: Klink
blackDescription: The two minigears that mesh together are predetermined. Each will rebound from other minigears without meshing.
whiteDescription: Interlocking two bodies and spinning around generates the energy they need to live.

name: Klang
blackDescription: By changing the direction in which it rotates, it communicates its feelings to others. When angry, it rotates faster.
whiteDescription: Spinning minigears are rotated at high speed and repeatedly fired away. It is dangerous if the gears don’t return.

name: Klinklang
blackDescription: Its red core functions as an energy tank. It fires the charged energy through its spikes into an area.
whiteDescription: The gear with the red core is rotated at high speed for a rapid energy charge.

name: Tynamo
blackDescription: While one alone doesn’t have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.
whiteDescription: These Pokemon move in schools. They have an electricity-generating organ, so they discharge electricity if in danger.

name: Eelektrik
blackDescription: They coil around foes and shock them with electricity-generating organs that seem simply to be circular patterns.
whiteDescription: These Pokemon have a big appetite. When they spot their prey, they attack it and paralyze it with electricity.

name: Eelektross
blackDescription: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.
whiteDescription: With their sucker mouths, they suck in prey. Then they use their fangs to shock the prey with electricity.

name: Elgyem
blackDescription: It uses its strong psychic power to squeeze its opponent’s brain, causing unendurable headaches.
whiteDescription: This Pokemon had never been seen until it appeared from far in the desert 50 years ago.

name: Beheeyem
blackDescription: It can manipulate an opponent’s memory. Apparently, it communicates by flashing its three different-colored fingers.
whiteDescription: It uses psychic power to control an opponent’s brain and tamper with its memories.

name: Litwick
blackDescription: Litwick shines a light that absorbs the life energy of people and Pokemon, which becomes the fuel that it burns.
whiteDescription: While shining a light and pretending to be a guide, it leeches off the life force of any who follow it.

name: Lampent
blackDescription: This ominous Pokemon is feared. Through cities it wanders, searching for the spirits of the fallen.
whiteDescription: It arrives near the moment of death and steals spirit from the body.

name: Chandelure
blackDescription: It absorbs a spirit, which it then burns. By waving the flames on its arms, it puts its foes into a hypnotic trance.
whiteDescription: Being consumed in Chandelure’s flame burns up the spirit, leaving the body behind.

name: Axew
blackDescription: They use their tusks to crush the berries they eat. Repeated regrowth makes their tusks strong and sharp.
whiteDescription: They mark their territory by leaving gashes in trees with their tusks. If a tusk breaks, a new one grows in quickly.

name: Fraxure
blackDescription: Since a broken tusk will not grow back, they diligently sharpen their tusks on river rocks after they’ve been fighting.
whiteDescription: Their tusks can shatter rocks. Territory battles between Fraxure can be intensely violent.

name: Haxorus
blackDescription: They are kind but can be relentless when defending territory. They challenge foes with tusks that can cut steel.
whiteDescription: Their sturdy tusks will stay sharp even if used to cut steel beams. These Pokemon are covered in hard armor.

name: Cubchoo
blackDescription: When it is not feeling well, its mucus gets watery and the power of its Ice-type moves decreases.
whiteDescription: Its nose is always running. It sniffs the snot back up because the mucus provides the raw material for its moves.

name: Beartic
blackDescription: It can make its breath freeze at will. Very able in the water, it swims around in northern seas and catches prey.
whiteDescription: It freezes its breath to create fangs and claws of ice to fight with. Cold northern areas are its habitat.

name: Cryogonal
blackDescription: When its body temperature goes up, it turns into steam and vanishes. When its temperature lowers, it returns to ice.
whiteDescription: They are born in snow clouds. They use chains made of ice crystals to capture prey.

name: Shelmet
blackDescription: When attacked, it defends itself by closing the lid of its shell. It can spit a sticky, poisonous liquid.
whiteDescription: It evolves when bathed in an electric-like energy along with Karrablast. The reason is still unknown.

name: Accelgor
blackDescription: When its body dries out, it weakens. So, to prevent dehydration, it wraps itself in many layers of thin membrane.
whiteDescription: Having removed its heavy shell, it becomes very light and can fight with ninja-like movements.

name: Stunfisk
blackDescription: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.
whiteDescription: It conceals itself in the mud of the seashore. Then it waits. When prey touch it, it delivers a jolt of electricity.

name: Mienfoo
blackDescription: In fights, they dominate with onslaughts of flowing, continuous attacks. With their sharp claws, they cut enemies.
whiteDescription: They have mastered elegant combos. As they concentrate, their battle moves become swifter and more precise.

name: Mienshao
blackDescription: It wields the fur on its arms like a whip. Its arm attacks come with such rapidity that they cannot even be seen.
whiteDescription: They use the long fur on their arms as a whip to strike their opponents.

name: Druddigon
blackDescription: It warms its body by absorbing sunlight with its wings. When its body temperature falls, it can no longer move.
whiteDescription: It races through narrow caves, using its sharp claws to catch prey. The skin on its face is harder than a rock.

name: Golett
blackDescription: The energy that burns inside it enables it to move, but no one has yet been able to identify this energy.
whiteDescription: These Pokemon are thought to have been created by the science of an ancient and mysterious civilization.

name: Golurk
blackDescription: It flies across the sky at Mach speeds. Removing the seal on its chest makes its internal energy go out of control.
whiteDescription: It is said that Golurk were ordered to protect people and Pokemon by the ancient people who made them.

name: Pawniard
blackDescription: Blades comprise this Pokemon’s entire body. If battling dulls the blades, it sharpens them on stones by the river.
whiteDescription: They fight at Bisharp’s command. They cling to their prey and inflict damage by sinking their blades into it.

name: Bisharp
blackDescription: It leads a group of Pawniard. It battles to become the boss, but will be driven from the group if it loses.
whiteDescription: Bisharp pursues prey in the company of a large group of Pawniard. Then Bisharp finishes off the prey.

name: Bouffalant
blackDescription: Their fluffy fur absorbs damage, even if they strike foes with a fierce headbutt.
whiteDescription: They charge wildly and headbutt everything. Their headbutts have enough destructive force to derail a train.

name: Rufflet
blackDescription: They crush berries with their talons. They bravely stand up to any opponent, no matter how strong it is.
whiteDescription: They will challenge anything, even strong opponents, without fear. Their frequent fights help them become stronger.

name: Braviary
blackDescription: They fight for their friends without any thought about danger to themselves. One can carry a car while flying.
whiteDescription: The more scars they have, the more respect these brave soldiers of the sky get from their peers.

name: Vullaby
blackDescription: Its wings are too tiny to allow it to fly. As the time approaches for it to evolve, it discards the bones it was wearing.
whiteDescription: They tend to guard their posteriors with suitable bones they have found. They pursue weak Pokemon.

name: Mandibuzz
blackDescription: It makes a nest out of bones it finds. It grabs weakened prey in its talons and hauls it to its nest of bones.
whiteDescription: Watching from the sky, they swoop to strike weakened Pokemon on the ground. They decorate themselves with bones.

name: Heatmor
blackDescription: It breathes through a hole in its tail while it burns with an internal fire. Durant is its prey.
whiteDescription: Using their very hot, flame-covered tongues, they burn through Durant’s steel bodies and consume their insides.

name: Durant
blackDescription: They attack in groups, covering themselves in steel armor to protect themselves from Heatmor.
whiteDescription: Durant dig nests in mountains. They build their complicated, interconnected tunnels into mazes.

name: Deino
blackDescription: It tends to bite everything, and it is not a picky eater. Approaching it carelessly is dangerous.
whiteDescription: They cannot see, so they tackle and bite to learn about their surroundings. Their bodies are covered in wounds.

name: Zweilous
blackDescription: After it has eaten up all the food in its territory, it moves to another area. Its two heads do not get along.
whiteDescription: Since their two heads do not get along and compete with each other for food, they always eat too much.

name: Hydreigon
blackDescription: This brutal Pokemon travels the skies on its six wings. Anything that moves seems like a foe to it, triggering its attack.
whiteDescription: The heads on their arms do not have brains. They use all three heads to consume and destroy everything.

name: Larvesta
blackDescription: This Pokemon was believed to have been born from the sun. When it evolves, its entire body is engulfed in flames.
whiteDescription: The base of volcanoes is where they make their homes. They shoot fire from their five horns to repel attacking enemies.

name: Volcarona
blackDescription: When volcanic ash darkened the atmosphere, it is said that Volcarona’s fire provided a replacement for the sun.
whiteDescription: A sea of fire engulfs the surroundings of their battles, since they use their six wings to scatter their ember scales.

name: Cobalion
blackDescription: This legendary Pokemon battled against humans to protect Pokemon. Its personality is calm and composed.
whiteDescription: It has a body and heart of steel. Its glare is sufficient to make even an unruly Pokemon obey it.

name: Terrakion
blackDescription: This Pokemon came to the defense of Pokemon that had lost their homes in a war among humans.
whiteDescription: Its charge is strong enough to break through a giant castle wall in one blow. This Pokemon is spoken of in legends.

name: Virizion
blackDescription: This Pokemon fought humans in order to protect its friends. Legends about it continue to be passed down.
whiteDescription: Its head sprouts horns as sharp as blades. Using whirlwind-like movements, it confounds and swiftly cuts opponents.

name: Tornadus
blackDescription: The lower half of its body is wrapped in a cloud of energy. It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.
whiteDescription: Tornadus expels massive energy from its tail, causing severe storms. Its power is great enough to blow houses away.

name: Thundurus
blackDescription: Countless charred remains mar the landscape of places through which Thundurus has passed.
whiteDescription: The spikes on its tail discharge immense bolts of lightning. It flies around the Unova region firing off lightning bolts.

name: Reshiram
blackDescription: This Pokemon appears in legends. It sends flames into the air from its tail, burning up everything around it.
whiteDescription: When Reshiram’s tail flares, the heat energy moves the atmosphere and changes the world’s weather.

name: Zekrom
blackDescription: Concealing itself in lightning clouds, it flies throughout the Unova region. It creates electricity in its tail.
whiteDescription: This Pokemon appears in legends. In its tail, it has a giant generator that creates electricity.

name: Landorus
blackDescription: Lands visited by Landorus grant such bountiful crops that it has been hailed as “The Guardian of the Fields.”
whiteDescription: The energy that comes pouring from its tail increases the nutrition in the soil, making crops grow to great size.

name: Kyurem
blackDescription: It generates a powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.
whiteDescription: It can produce ultracold air. Its body is frozen.

name: Keldeo
blackDescription: By blasting water from its hooves, it can glide across water. It excels at using leg moves while battling.
whiteDescription: It crosses the world, running over the surfaces of oceans and rivers. It appears at scenic waterfronts.

name: Meloetta
blackDescription: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.
whiteDescription: Many famous songs have been inspired by the melodies that Meloetta plays.

name: Genesect
blackDescription: Over 300 million years ago, it was feared as the strongest of hunters. It has been modified by Team Plasma.
whiteDescription: This ancient bug Pokemon was altered by Team Plasma. They upgraded the cannon on its back.
